functions.name: core_timer_init_freq
functions.signature: core_timer_init_freq(core_timer_t * h, TIM_TypeDef * instance, uint32_t freq_hz)
functions.brief: Initialize a timer at a given overflow frequency. Use for PWM output and periodic tick — the frequency is how often the counter wraps (= the PWM frequency). core_timer_init_freq(&t, TIM2, 1000);   // overflows at 1 kHz

functions.name: core_timer_init_tick
functions.signature: core_timer_init_tick(core_timer_t * h, TIM_TypeDef * instance, uint32_t tick_hz)
functions.brief: Initialize a timer at a given tick rate, free-running to max count. Use for input capture — the tick rate sets the measurement resolution, and the counter runs as long as possible before wrapping (0xFFFF for 16-bit, 0xFFFFFFFF for 32-bit TIM2). core_timer_init_tick(&t, TIM2, 1000000);  // 1 us per tick core_timer_capture_init(&t, 1); core_timer_start(&t);

functions.name: core_timer_pwm_set
functions.signature: core_timer_pwm_set(core_timer_t * h, uint8_t channel, uint16_t duty_permil)
functions.brief: Set PWM duty cycle for a channel. channel:      1–4 duty_permil:  0–1000 (0 = off, 500 = 50%, 1000 = always on)

functions.name: core_timer_capture_init
functions.brief: Configure a channel for input capture (rising edge). The timer must already be initialized with core_timer_init().

functions.name: core_timer_capture_read
functions.brief: Read the last captured value from a channel.

functions.name: core_timer_enable_tick
functions.signature: core_timer_enable_tick(core_timer_t * h, core_callback_t cb, void * ctx)
functions.brief: Enable periodic tick on an already-initialized timer. Does NOT touch PSC/ARR — the timer keeps its existing timebase. The callback fires on each counter overflow at the timer's frequency. Typical pattern: core_timer_init(&t, TIM2, 1000);         // 1 kHz timebase core_timer_pwm_set(&t, 1, 500);          // CH1 = 50% PWM (permil) core_timer_enable_tick(&t, on_tick, NULL); // also fire ISR at 1 kHz core_timer_start(&t);

functions.name: core_timer_disable_tick
functions.brief: Disable the tick callback (clears UIE, keeps timer running).

functions.name: core_tick_init
functions.signature: core_tick_init(core_timer_t * h, TIM_TypeDef * instance, uint32_t period_us, core_callback_t cb, void * ctx)
functions.brief: Convenience: initialize a timer as a tick-only source. Sets up the timebase AND enables the update interrupt. Use this when the timer's only job is a periodic callback. core_tick_init(&t, TIM3, 500000, on_tick, NULL);  // 2 Hz core_timer_start(&t);
